repositoryPage.whatACheckTreatsAs: What a check treats as a failure. Only findings the default branch does not have, and nobody has triaged, can fail it.
repositoryPage.itsScansFindingsAndDecisions: Its scans, findings and decisions are deleted. A later scan creates it again, without them.
repositoryPage.whatEachScanOfThe: What each scan of the default branch reported, of the last 50 scans.
repositoryPage.nothingHasBeenSentFor: Nothing has been sent for this repository.
repositoryPage.scanningDescription: This repository comes from {{forge}}. An agent scans its default branch each time it moves.
repositoryPage.headNotScanned: The latest commit, {{commit}}, is not scanned yet.
repositoryPage.setInTheFile: The repositories file says whether this repository is scanned.
repositoryPage.archivedDetail: It is archived on its forge, or gone from the account. It is no longer scanned and its findings are not counted as open; it comes back, with them, once it is active there again.

scanPage.itMayBeOlderThan: It may be older than the retention period.
scanPage.aScanOfTheDefault: A scan of the default branch is the baseline; everything it reports is new the first time.
scanPage.findingsTheDefaultBranchDoes: Findings the default branch does not have.

setupPage.runAnyAnalyserThatWrites: Run any analyser that writes SARIF in CI and send the result here. The answer says whether the check passes.
setupPage.useSastIngestTokenSet: Use SAST_INGEST_TOKEN, set where sast runs, or an API token with the editor role from API tokens.
setupPage.scansOfTheDefaultBranch: Scans of the default branch are the baseline. Any other branch, or any scan with pullRequest, reports only what the baseline does not have and nobody has triaged.
setupPage.aFindingKeepsItsIdentity: A finding keeps its identity when its line moves: it is found by rule, file and the code it matched.
setupPage.aFalsePositiveOrAccepted: A false positive or accepted risk follows the finding to every branch, so it does not fail the next pull request.
setupPage.underRepositoriesYouChooseWhich: Under Repositories you choose which severity fails a check, and which branch is the default.

welcomePage.findingsShowHereAsSoon: Findings show here as soon as the first scan of a default branch arrives.

settingsPage.askAnAdminOfThis: Ask an admin of this sast for access.

githubPage.title: GitHub and GitLab
githubPage.description: sast follows the repositories of the GitHub and GitLab accounts here, not archived ones. An agent scans each default branch when it moves, and each open pull request or merge request into it, whose result goes back to the forge as the commit status OpenAsy SAST and one comment listing what it adds. Code stays with the agent; sast keeps only findings.
githubPage.noAgentOnlineDetail: Scans wait in the queue until an agent asks for them. Add one below and start it with its command.
githubPage.accountsDescription: From {{path}}, looked at every few minutes. A repository can be turned off on its own page, unless the file says.
githubPage.noAccountsDetail: Add the GitHub organizations and GitLab groups to the repositories file, and put each token in secrets/sast.env under the name the file gives it. A change to the file is applied within a minute; a new token needs a restart of sast.
githubPage.agentsDescription: sast-agent clones and scans the code, where it can reach GitHub or GitLab. It connects to sast; sast never connects to it.
githubPage.name: Name
githubPage.noAgentsDetail: Add one to scan repositories from GitHub and GitLab.
githubPage.agentNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes, such as dc1.
githubPage.ruleSourcesDescription: Public git repositories of Opengrep rules, fetched by the agent for each scan, next to the rules OpenAsy ships. A source and its licence are this install's choice.
githubPage.ruleSourceHint: An https git URL. At most 10.
githubPage.scanJobsDescription: The latest 200, newest first. A job an agent does not finish goes back to the queue, three times at most.
githubPage.noJobsDetail: Each default branch is queued once its account is connected.
githubPage.startAgentDescription: Run this where the agent can reach sast and the forge. The token works once, for 7 days, and is not shown again.
githubPage.noFileDetail: Set OPENASY_REPOSITORIES to a YAML file of forge accounts, and give sast their tokens in secrets/sast.env. The file is the only way to connect an account.
githubPage.fileNotApplied: The repositories file is not applied
githubPage.fileNotAppliedDetail: {{error}} The accounts from its last good version stay until it is fixed ({{path}}).
githubPage.fileWarnings: The repositories file is applied, with things to fix
githubPage.moveToFileDetail: These accounts were connected in the UI before the file. Add them to it as below and put each token in secrets/sast.env; the file then takes them over, with their repositories and findings.

rulesPage.title: Rules
rulesPage.description: sast-agent scans with OpenAsy's own rules, the rule sources under GitHub, and the rule files here. A rule switched off reports nothing in agent scans, whichever file it comes from. Scans CI sends use CI's own rules.
rulesPage.ownDescription: In Opengrep's format. A file Opengrep cannot read fails the next scan, and the scan job says why.
rulesPage.name: Name
rulesPage.noOwn: No rule files of your own
rulesPage.noOwnDetail: Write rules for what your code must not do, such as a call your team has banned.
rulesPage.disabledDescription: Rule ids, as findings show them. A finding of a rule switched off is marked fixed at the next scan of the default branch.
rulesPage.editDescription: An Opengrep rule file of up to 256 KiB; several rules can share one file. It is used from the next scan on.
rulesPage.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

overviewPage.openOverTimeDetail: At the end of each of the last 30 days, by severity. Triaged findings and archived repositories are left out.
overviewPage.newAndFixedDetail: Findings first found and fixed on the default branches, in each of the last 12 weeks.
overviewPage.topRules: Rules with the most open findings
overviewPage.topRulesDetail: A rule high on this list may be noise: triage its findings, or turn it off under Rules.
overviewPage.topRepositories: Repositories with the most open findings
overviewPage.topRepositoriesDetail: Open findings of each repository's default branch.
overviewPage.checksPassedDetail: Pull request checks of the last 30 days that found nothing new at or above the bar.
